attchmntText: Eros International Media Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Eros International Media Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss before tax of 1,828 Lakhs for the half year. Net worth has eroded entirely, triggering a material uncertainty related to going concern. The statutory auditor issued a qualified conclusion due to long overdue trade receivables from group entities totaling 61,878 Lakhs net of payables, with a provision of 29,025 Lakhs made for expected credit losses. The financial impact of pending Reserve Bank of India approval for net remittance is currently not ascertainable. Additionally, the company is responding to a Show Cause Notice from the Securities and Exchange Board of India regarding content advances of 1,01,601 Lakhs. The auditor noted that previous reports for the year ended March 31, 2026, and the quarter ended June 30, 2026, were also qualified on similar grounds.

attchmntText: Eros International Media Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Eros International Media Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. A Limited Review Report on these results was issued by Haribhakti & Co. LLP, the Statutory Auditors of the Company. The Board Meeting commenced at 4:15 p.m. and concluded at 5:30 p.m. The company also noted other routine business during the session.
